issues.detail: The Hebrew subject is Ahab (אַחְאָב), but the Vietnamese renders 'Ê-li' (Elijah), swapping the actor.

The Hebrew 'bə-ḵol bənê yiśrā'ēl' means 'throughout all the sons/people of Israel'; the Vietnamese 'khắp các chi phái Ít-ra-en' (throughout all the tribes of Israel) narrows 'sons/people' to 'tribes', a substantive change in scope.
